request_summary: Add a fixed in-code agent rule catalogue plus a coordinator agent that decomposes a user request into a validated sub-agent task plan.
rationale: C1: 5 edit-target files in one package, no one-way door — pre-declared write scope required; prior C1 undeclared_path breach is re-measured on the corrected footprint, floored at C1 and never escalated twice (5 edit-target files / 0 package(s) / 1 write-scope clusters / co-change unassessed / shape=scaffolded)
entry_point: AI Assistant chat: the coordinator agent receives the user request and produces the delegated sub-agent task list that the orchestrator then executes.
done_oracle: A fixed in-code rule catalogue defines every agent's obligations, prohibitions and required evidence; a coordinator agent turns a user request into a delegated task list whose every ruleId exists in the catalogue and is not the coordinator itself, and any unknown or self-referential ruleId is rejected rather than dispatched. The coordinator never performs specialist work itself. Tests cover: catalogue immutability and uniqueness, rejection of unknown ruleId, rejection of delegating to the coordinator rule, and acceptance of a valid multi-task plan.
